Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Indicates means of identification of a derivative event.

TimeStamp.name: Time Stamp
TimeStamp.definition: Indicates the time stamp of a derivative event.

AmendmentIndicator.name: Amendment Indicator
AmendmentIndicator.definition: Indicator of whether the modification of the swap transaction reflects newly agreed upon term(s) from the previously negotiated terms resulting in price forming event.||Usage: When absent, meaning of AmendmentIndicator is False.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
